elaine.cs: FYI Aurelia Health (AU-3421) flagged growth — 3 new teams coming through (frontend search, analytics, localization) + a localization use case. We're seeing a 2.1x qps spike in the last 24h. Likely ask: Dedicated pilot or short-term burst. Tagging @mike.csm for expansion / renewal signal and @sarah.engineer for infra/ops input.

mike.csm: Thanks — did CS do a quick discovery? Do they have an ETA? Renewal cycle is ~9 months out so good timing to upsell.

elaine.cs: Did a quick discovery call yesterday. Timeline: pilots in ~6 weeks, prod in ~3 months if pilot successful. They noted EU data residency requirements for localization.

sarah.engineer: Good data — first pass recommendation: Dedicated pilot in EU region + option for Private (VPC) if legal requires. Need concrete traffic numbers (peak/sustained/concurrency) and latency SLOs to size.

elaine.cs: Sample telemetry: peak qps ~520, sustained ~230, p95 latency target <250ms. They also have nightly bulk embedding jobs (batch ingestion windows). Quick snippet they shared:
```
{
  "peak_qps": 520,
  "sustained_qps": 230,
  "batch_window": "02:00-05:00 CET",
  "latency_p95_target_ms": 250
}
```

ryan_se: If we provision Dedicated, we can offer a 4-week pilot with autoscale + burst policy. I'll draft a resource estimate (GPUs + network) and an SOW. Also will note recommended quantization profiles.

mike.csm: I'll schedule an enablement workshop with their infra and ML leads next Tue — @sarah.engineer can you join? We'll want to capture enablement items and prompt/eval setup.

sarah.engineer: Yep. I'll prepare a checklist: network & firewall rules, KMS key workflow, model pinning/rollouts, batch cadence. Also confirm whether they want private eval harness.

elaine.cs: They specifically asked about cost tradeoffs between quantization vs batching — any quick guidance?

infra-bot: Quick note for AU-3421: recommended baseline for pilot = 8 x A10G-equivalent GPU nodes with int8 quantization for inference. Expected cost reduction: ~55% vs fp16; intelligent batching can add ~15–25% savings depending on latency tolerance. See internal doc: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/au-3421-sizing

ryan_se: Draft SOW uploaded to shared drive and linked in support thread. Paging legal for NDA / EU data addendum (@legal-bot).

mike.csm: Also flagging this as a potential expansion opportunity for ARR uplift — I'll run an initial LTV/ACV estimate and loop AM.

elaine.cs: I'll collect their prompt sets and eval dataset ahead of the workshop and send a pre-read. Anything else we should surface?

sarah.engineer: Please confirm their batch window (they said CET) and whether they require real-time fallbacks (low-latency fallbacks to smaller models). Also capture any compliance questions.

mike.csm: Great — moving to action items: 1) enablement workshop invite (mike). 2) infra SOW draft (ryan). 3) eval dataset + prompts (elaine). 4) legal NDA check (legal-bot). Will update thread after workshop. :thumbsup:
